messages:
simran: Quick intake for Sable-3B — proposing as a low-latency, cost-efficient mobile/dev tier. Goals: p50 latency <60ms hosted, cost <=0.8x current model, <=1% quality regression on our QA suite.

devon: What's the comparator? Raven-6B or current production? Do we have baseline evals?

simran: Baseline is Raven-6B for short answers, but prod baseline is Falconx7B for some routes. Initial offline evals show Sable is close on short QA, weaker on long-form code generation. Need structured quantization experiments (int8 -> int4/GPTQ) + KV cache behavior.

marta: Product asks for retrieval A/B tests and explicit rollback triggers. If hallucination rate >2x baseline we must rollback immediately.

devon: Plan for quant pipeline: 1) baseline evals 2) int8 quant + calibration 3) int4 (GPTQ) 4) post-quant lightweight finetune if needed. Eval sets: llmqa, conv-safety, retrieval-ranking.

alicia: Add prompt perturbation tests (prefix/suffix), top-10 customer prompts human eval, and deterministic seed smoke. I'll own the human eval run.

ian: Infra notes: For Dedicated we need GPU proc mapping doc. Hosted rollout should be gradual: 5% -> 25% -> 50% across us-west/us-east/eu-west, with warmup to populate KV cache. Also confirm kernel/torch compile matrix for int4.

eva: SRE: define SLOs & automations. Suggested: auto-fallback if token error rate or latency spike >20% or if eval delta quality < -0.02 for 2 consecutive hours. Alert to oncall and product.

simran: Proposed quantitative acceptance thresholds: EM drop <=1% on qa-core, human helpfulness delta >= -0.05, latency p50 <=60ms hosted (small batch), cost per token <=0.8x baseline.

devon: Uploaded eval harness (internal): https://redwood.internal/evals/sable3b — running int8 first. Will post artifacts.

devon: Draft canary config snippet:
```
canary_percentages: [5, 25, 50]
stages_duration: [24h, 48h, 72h]
fallback_model: raven-6b
metrics: [latency_p50, latency_p95, error_rate, eval_delta_quality]
rollout_gate: auto-fallback on eval_delta_quality < -0.02 or latency_p95 > baseline*1.5
```

ian: Note for Private deployments: Sable int4 uses a larger KV memory footprint in our tests. We'll need memory profile + a small-capacity Dedicated pool before offering on-prem.

alicia: QA checklist (short):
- conv-safety suite (pass/fail)
- hallucination probe (50 targeted prompts) threshold: hallucination_rate <= baseline*2
- retrieval re-rank accuracy (nDCG) within -0.01
- deterministic seed smoke with fixed prompt set
Please add owner and SLA for each item.

marta: Prioritization: customers asking for cheaper mobile infer -> HIGH priority. Recommendation: hosted first (fast feedback), then Dedicated for enterprise, Private on customer request.

eva: Ops automation draft: set rollout automation to auto-fallback if eval_delta_quality < -0.02 OR latency_p95 > baseline*1.5 for two consecutive windows; send incident to #incidents and tag oncall.

devon: First int8 run summary: EM -0.6% vs baseline, latency p50 improved by 12%, no new errors. Scheduling int4+GPTQ runs and post-quant temperature calibration.

simran: Timeline proposal: quant runs (devon) 24-48h, human evals (alicia) 72h, staging canary next week, hosted canary Thursday -> escalate to 25% if metrics stable.

ops-bot: deploy-plan created: /plans/sable3b/2026-03-canary (created by devon) :white_check_mark:

marta: tagging stakeholders: @eng-ml @eng-platform @sre — please add any missing blockers.

ian: Blocker: need a CI job for int4 kernel smoke on our smallest GPU instance. I'll open an infra PR.

devon: Will add eval artifacts and a short writeup to the plan. Also adding a prompt set for mobile brevity tests.

simran: Thanks everyone — will follow up with a concise checklist doc after initial quant results land. :rocket:
